description: MCP fingerprinter. generate_fingerprint(server_id)->dict: creates a stable behavioral fingerprint for an MCP server combining: tool_name_hash (SHA256 of sorted tool names), description_tokens (top 20 significant words), permission_scope_hash, domain_fingerprint, version_string. Fingerprints stored in mcp_fingerprints table. compare_fingerprints(fp_a,fp_b)->float 0-1 similarity. detect_impersonation(server_id)->list: finds existing servers with >0.8 fingerprint similarity. Used by rug_pull_monitor and behavioral_analyser. No daemon.
